svg.title: Heedfulness and the Cultivation of Skillful Qualities

g.text: Heedfulness and the Cultivation of Skillful Qualities
For Non-Arising of Unarisen Unskillful Qualities
Obstacles (Sensual Desire, Ill Will, Sloth, Restlessness, Uncertainty);
For Abandoning of Arisen Unskillful Qualities
For Arising of Unarisen Skillful Qualities
For Maintenance, Development, & Culmination of Arisen Skillful Qualities
Five Faculties (Conviction, Persistence, Mindfulness, Concentration, Discernment) Develop
Right Resolve, Speech, Action, Livelihood, Effort, Mindfulness, Concentration
Attain Awakening / Unexcelled Freedom from Bondage
